status: post-hoc development-only diagnostic; prior evaluation outcomes already known globally, not newly used here
reconstruction: Fixed Ridge alpha=1, solver=svd; CPU float64; fold-local mean imputation and StandardScaler of inputs; fold-local target centering/scaling; original frozen family folds; no grid or tuning
within_family: All failure/nonfailure pairs within each mixed-outcome family; larger feature treated as larger risk; ties=0.5; equal-family mean concordance; raw features and M-reconstruction OOF residuals; both panels; per-family and same-construction pair accounting
conditional_permutation: Preserve failure count within each mixed family, labels shared across both panels and representations; max absolute concordance departure from0.5 over all24 fixed raw/residual panel-feature columns within each cohort; exact enumeration when combinations<=50000, otherwise5000 fixed-seed draws plus-one Monte Carlo p values. Descriptive conditional randomisation diagnostics, not confirmatory evidence; exchangeability across construction/initialisation is an assumption
variance: Run-weighted within-family and between-family sums of squares; proportions sum to1 unless flat; no population variance inference
panel_noise: RMS(A-B)/sqrt(2), compared descriptively with population SD of panel-average raw and family-centred feature; complementary fixed panels, not numerical jitter or independent dataset replications
existing_predictors: Read only saved development OOF scores for logistic M/MZ and L6/B; no pipeline deserialisation, fitting, refitting, tuning or new risk model. OOF diagnostics remain development-selection-biased
interpretation: R2>=0.8 is a descriptive substantial-reconstructability marker, not proof of conditional outcome redundancy. Low Ridge R2 does not establish unique predictive information. Small mixed-family support limits within-setting claims. No result rescues the failed fresh primary gate or authorises a manuscript update, new classifier training, feature selection or external benchmark.
